about: One line per verdict a person gave on a generated vine nest in the Vines tool's Nest tab: Good or Bad, with what the nest measured when planned and, if it was played, how the play went. Nothing is removed: bad nests are kept as carefully as good ones. A nest is grown the same on every machine from its kit, seed and population, given the same generator.

fields.time: When the verdict was given, UTC, ISO 8601.
fields.note: What the person wrote, if anything.
fields.kit: The NestKit resource's path: the vine kinds and the layout rules.
fields.population: Pickles asked for, one pod each.
fields.horde: Whether it was played with the horde.
fields.generator: The git commit the generator was at, with "+changes" when its code had uncommitted edits.
fields.plan: What the plan measured: vines, pods, short (pickles left without a pod), radius_m (from the heart), slots and slots_used, avenues, shifted (moved to high-pod kinds to fit), kinds (vines and mean pods per kind), spacing_min_m and spacing_mean_m (to the nearest neighbour), rolls and rejected (vine rolls, and those failing validation), reasons (rejections by reason), grow_seconds.
fields.play: Null if it was judged without playing. Else: played_seconds, swings (grapple catches), seconds_to_heart (within 30 m of the heart's vine; -1 never), ground_touches (landings on the planet's ground, not a vine), pods, pods_destroyed, pickles_starting, pickles_left, killed_on_pods, woke, outcome (asleep, fighting or cleared), bonus (every pickle killed), times_pickled (the player downed).
